 Stephen Curry (rest) ruled out Saturday 
 by Chris Schommer | Warriors Correspondent | Sat, Oct 24th 2026, 5:17pm EDT 
 Stephen Curry (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday’s contest between the Golden State Warriors and Phoenix Suns according to Anthony Slater. ( Anthony Slater on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Curry will receive the night off for head coach Steve Kerr, with De’Anthony Melton, Gary Payton II, Brandin Williams, and Will Richard to split minutes in the Golden State backcourt against the Suns Saturday night.
 Steph Curry officially ruled out tonight in Phoenix for the Warriors first back-to-back. Right knee management. Brandin Podziemski and Al Horford also out. Draymond Green is doubtful.
— Anthony Slater (@anthonyVslater) October 24, 2026
